title: Installed vs planned
decision: What is installed per storey against the plan this week, and where are we behind?

data.note: Duplex Apartment elements with their class, storey, STEP id, and GlobalId

Install events invented by a rule: a 15-week plan by storey and class in build order (footings, slabs, walls and frame, roof, windows and doors, coverings, furniture), elements spread over each activity in STEP id order, then a delay per activity (Level 2 walls and frame, the roof, and later Level 2 and roof work 2 weeks late, Level 2 slabs 1 week late, Level 1 windows, doors, and coverings 1 week early); status at week 9
Duplex Apartment federated model for the 3D view, matched to the events by STEP id
